newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hot stocks fail to lift Shenzhen B index at close.
newsitem.headline: Hot stocks fail to lift Shenzhen B index at close.

text.p: Shenzhen's B shares ended lower on Thursday despite strong gains by individual stocks, and traders said they expected the index to move sideways in the next few sessions with the mood cautious.
The B index edged down 0.98 points or 0.60 percent to close at 162.14 points on turnover of HK$88.4 million, compared with Wednesday's HK$85 million.
"Zhonghao and Tellus are hot, but market mood is unchanged," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
"The index is unlikely to fall below the 160-point support level, but neither will it jump in cautious mood," he said.
Shares of Shenzhen Zhonghao Group Co closed HK$0.40 or 9.28 percent higher at HK$4.71 on talk of financial reconstructuring, traders said. Volume was 445,633 shares.
A company official said Zhonghao was "going through structural changes," but declined to elaborate.
Shenzhen Tellus Machinery & Electronics Co hit 10 percent limit-up for the second consecutive day, surging on market hopes that it will post good 1996 results, analysts said.
It closed at HK$4.00, up HK$0.36 on volume of 1.4 million shares.

Caution during the company reporting season, which ends on April 30, is likely to bind the index, traders said, adding that turnover was thin ahead of Friday's trade suspension in line with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange's Easter holiday closure.
"Investors held back ahead of the long weekend," an analyst at J&A Securities said.
A Shenzhen stock exchange official said the exchange would suspend trading in B shares from Friday until next Tuesday.
The A share index lost 1.48 points or 0.33 percent to end at 450.33 points on turnover of 12.6 billion yuan, compared with Wednesday's 13.3 billion yuan.
